descriptor.underlying_event: Lakers vs Celtics: will the Lakers win?

policy.human_readable_rules: In-play entry allowed while the executable book stays inside a 12-cent spread. CLOSE_ONLY during the final two minutes of play. Max 3x. The risk premium covers 50% of the hold-to-resolution floor value because one score can decide the event. Before resolution, maintenance for losing positions ramps to 50%.
